verdict.rationale: The only evidence that a free tier exists is a community report quoting the Brave Search API free tier's terms. That same report says the free-tier terms prohibit using responses for AI inference, and users note AI use requires a separate AI Inference plan. This is a significant caveat for developers prototyping agent or RAG workflows. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the free tier or free credits, published free-tier quotas and rate limits, a clear statement of what prototyping uses the free tier permits.
